descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione You prepare HR key figures for various internal and external statistics, accounting and reports and create and analyze periodic reports and evaluations for internal stakeholders. You carry out the recurring booking processes. Reconciling balance sheet accounts and ensuring our data quality is also your area of ​​responsibility. You are the contact person for our line managers to analyze our personnel costs. You are jointly responsible for the further development and professionalization of HR controlling instruments and processes. You support the HR controlling team in projects and other tasks, are the contact person for internal HRM inquiries and work closely with the finance department. --- Mansioni - Provide various internal and external statistics, invoices and reports and prepare HR key figures - Create and analyze periodic reports and evaluations for internal stakeholders - Carry out recurring booking processes - Compare balance sheet accounts and ensure data quality - Be available to line managers as a contact person for the analysis of personnel costs - Be jointly responsible for the further development and professionalization of HR controlling instruments and processes - Support the HR controlling team in projects and other tasks - Processing of HRM-internal inquiries - Close collaboration with the finance department ---
• Requirements - Business studies or comparable training - Knowledge of (payroll) accounting - Several years of work in HR controlling and/or finance and accounting - Technical expertise and high IT affinity, especially in Excel, Access databases, Power Query, Power BI, MIS systems such as HCe - Analytical and structured way of working with a high level of quality awareness - Enjoyment conceptual tasks as well as recurring activities ---

descriptionByLocale.it:
I vostri compiti Trattate neonati, bambini e adolescenti da 0 a 18 anni con fisioterapia in regime ambulatoriale con il coinvolgimento delle famiglie. You work in an interdisciplinary manner with other outpatient therapy areas in the house (occupational therapy, psychomotor therapy, speech therapy) as well as with internal and external specialists from hospitals, schools, care facilities and other therapy centers. Approfondirai ed espanderai continuamente le tue capacità professionali per garantire la qualità.
• Your profile Completed training as a physiotherapist HF/FH/BSc or foreign diploma with SRK recognition Proven professional experience in the field of outpatient pediatrics, ideally with a comparably diverse clientele Additional pediatric training is required Very good knowledge of spoken and written German (at least level B2) Personal resilience for working with seriously ill patients Professional and personal flexibility for independent and team-oriented work Rachel Cott Head of Therapies Zurich +41 44 249 45 86 Employer Children's Hospital Zurich With around 3,000 employees, the Children's Hospital Zurich is the largest university children's hospital in Switzerland and one of the leading centers for child and adolescent medicine in Europe. Ma la cosa più bella di “Kispi” sono i più piccoli: ogni anno vengono curati fino a 100.000 pazienti e in 47 reparti specializzati facciamo di tutto per il loro benessere. Al Kispi non sono importanti solo le attrezzature più moderne e la massima qualità dei trattamenti, ma anche un buon feeling per i rapporti interpersonali. Oltre all'intero spettro medico e chirurgico pediatrico, l'ospedale pediatrico offre anche un centro di riabilitazione e un centro di ricerca unici.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Your tasks You treat infants, children and young people aged 0-18 with physiotherapy in an outpatient setting with the involvement of families. You work in an interdisciplinary manner with other outpatient therapy areas in the house (occupational therapy, psychomotor therapy, speech therapy) as well as with internal and external specialists from hospitals, schools, care facilities and other therapy centers. You will continuously deepen and expand your professional skills to ensure quality.
• Your profile Completed training as a physiotherapist HF/FH/BSc or foreign diploma with SRK recognition Proven professional experience in the field of outpatient pediatrics, ideally with a comparably diverse clientele Additional pediatric training is required Very good knowledge of spoken and written German (at least level B2) Personal resilience for working with seriously ill patients Professional and personal flexibility for independent and team-oriented work Rachel Cott Head of Therapies Zurich +41 44 249 45 86 Employer Children's Hospital Zurich With around 3,000 employees, the Children's Hospital Zurich is the largest university children's hospital in Switzerland and one of the leading centers for child and adolescent medicine in Europe. But the greatest thing about “Kispi” is the little ones: up to 100,000 patients are cared for every year, and we do everything for their well-being in 47 specialist departments. Not only the most modern equipment and the highest quality of treatment are important at Kispi, but also a good feeling for interpersonal relationships. In addition to the entire pediatric medical and pediatric surgical spectrum, the children's hospital also offers a unique rehabilitation center and a research center.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Description of the work

Economia aziendale, comunicazione, gestione non-profit) o formazione comparabile Esperienza pluriennale di leadership nella raccolta fondi con comprovato successo in contesti impegnativi Forti competenze nella costruzione e nel mantenimento di una rete sostenibile e pertinente Modo di lavorare imprenditoriale, strutturato e costantemente orientato all'implementazione con un occhio all'impatto e alla qualità Comunicazione molto sicura e adeguata al destinatario in tedesco e inglese nonché elevata persuasività nel trattare con stakeholder esigenti Oliver Sack Presidente Eleonorenstiftung Datore di lavoro Bambini Ospedale di Zurigo Con circa 3.000 dipendenti, l'Ospedale pediatrico di Zurigo è il più grande ospedale pediatrico universitario della Svizzera e uno dei centri leader in Europa per la medicina infantile e adolescenziale.
